skill.description: Use an Apify Actor to collect public emails, phone numbers, social profiles, and contact pages from websites into normalized records.
skill.summary: Extract public website contact details through Apify with configurable crawl limits and JSON output.

content.user_title: Extract Public Website Emails and Phone Numbers
content.value_statement: Collecting public contact details across websites takes repeated manual searches. This skill submits website lists to an Apify Actor and returns organized contact records.
actual_capabilities: Submit website URLs or bare domains to the documented Apify Actor through a Node runner or API examples.
Request public emails, phone numbers, social profiles, addresses, and contact page links in normalized website records.
Configure page limits, page concurrency, website concurrency, and request timeouts.
Configure contact-page prioritization, sitemap discovery, robots.txt handling, and limited JavaScript rendering through Actor inputs.
Select a default phone country, exclude named email addresses, and filter out records without contacts.
Print synchronous results as JSON or use documented asynchronous API requests to retrieve a run dataset.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, network access, and usage charges; the bundled runner also requires Node 18 or later.
Crawling executes in an external Actor whose implementation and data retention controls are not included in these files.
Supports public pages only; blocked, inaccessible, or complex JavaScript pages may yield incomplete results, and contact accuracy is not verified.
The runner prints JSON, not CSV; larger runs require the separate asynchronous workflow, and named email collection is enabled by default.

use_cases.title: Refresh Supplier Contact Records
use_cases.description: Collect published role emails and phone numbers from approved supplier websites for manual directory updates.

use_cases.title: Audit Published Contact Details
use_cases.description: Review contact pages across owned websites and compare returned details with approved company records.

use_cases.title: Compile Public Organization Contacts
use_cases.description: Gather public organization contact links and crawl metadata for a research directory, subject to site terms and privacy requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Find One Website's Contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find public contact details for [website]. Limit the crawl to five pages, respect robots.txt, and exclude named emails. Confirm Apify costs before running.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect a single approved website.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Role Contacts Across Websites
prompt_templates.prompt: Process [approved website list] with ten pages per site and includeNamedEmails disabled. Keep robots.txt enabled. Summarize primary contacts and sites without results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a small contact directory.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Regional Contact Crawl
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare input for [approved websites] using defaultCountry [country code], maxPagesPerSite 15, maxConcurrency 2, and maxSitesConcurrency 1. Exclude named emails and respect robots.txt.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: configure phone interpretation and request volume.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Asynchronous Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous Apify run for [approved website list]. Use conservative concurrency, respect robots.txt, and exclude named emails. Confirm costs before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: retrieve and review a larger run dataset.

output: Illustrative result, not a live crawl.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: review a website where crawling returns no public contacts.
output: Illustrative result, not a live crawl.
Social profiles and contact forms: none returned.
Review status, failure details, and robots.txt skips before concluding that the website has no contacts.

best_practices: Start with a small approved website list and conservative page limits, then check Apify usage charges before expanding.
Keep respectRobotsTxt enabled, follow website terms, and disable includeNamedEmails when role contacts are sufficient.
Store APIFY_TOKEN in the environment, submit only intended public inputs, and review returned contacts before using or sharing them.
anti_patterns: Do not submit cookies, session credentials, private account data, or unrelated local files as crawl input.
Do not disable robots.txt protections or increase concurrency to bypass restrictions without authorization.
Do not treat extracted contacts as verified identities or permission for spam, harassment, or unlawful discrimination.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, and network access. The bundled Node runner requires Node 18 or later.

faq.question: Does the crawler run entirely on my computer?
faq.answer: No. The local runner submits input to an external Apify Actor and prints its returned dataset as JSON.

faq.question: Does using this skill cost money?
faq.answer: Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Check the Actor's current pricing and test with a small page limit.

faq.question: Can I exclude personal email addresses?
faq.answer: Set includeNamedEmails to false to request role addresses instead of named personal addresses. Named email collection is enabled by default.

faq.question: Can it access private pages or guarantee every contact?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for public pages only, and website restrictions or rendering limits can produce incomplete results.

faq.question: Which output formats and run modes are provided?
faq.answer: The runner returns synchronous results as JSON. Documentation also provides an asynchronous dataset workflow for larger runs; CSV conversion is separate.
